selection.name: agentsview
selection.role: C07: Co-finalist for a local searchable session archive and analytics dashboard, with CLI and MCP access. An alternative clean install to ccx; no measured winner is established.
selection.install_source: https://github.com/kenn-io/agentsview/blob/v0.44.0/README.md#install — latest published release verified as v0.44.0 on 2026-10-02.

basis.shows: Documents discovery of Claude Code and Codex session files, a local SQLite archive, transcript browsing, full-text search, tool analytics, and per-session cost reporting. The core viewer runs locally without a hosted analytics service.

Published 2026-09-21. Provides Linux amd64 and macOS arm64 binaries. Release notes document MCP session/content search and transcript-linked activity views. Linux compatibility makes WSL2 a plausible target; execution on the target host was not measured.

Upstream tests exercise Codex function calls, token usage, repeated-prompt deduplication, late token-count events, and incremental tool-result updates. These establish parser regression coverage, not agreement with live client counters.
The upstream CI definition includes backend tests, frontend validation, and Playwright end-to-end tests. Public test infrastructure is broader than a build-only check.
Default-branch CI completed successfully on 2026-10-01 at commit d37642206051dababc436635024676c17dddac45. This is HEAD evidence, not a verification of every behavior in the older published release.
The separate macOS CI workflow completed successfully on the same default-branch commit.
Repository is not archived. License is MIT, recorded as information only.
Latest default-branch commit is dated 2026-10-01, inside the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-04.
An archive-upsert correctness report remained open and was updated 2026-10-01. Issue activity is current; this report warrants an ingestion regression case in the deciding comparison.

selection.name: ccx
selection.role: C10: Co-finalist for terminal and agent-driven inspection, citable tool traces, and a local web viewer. An alternative clean install to agentsview; no measured winner is established.
selection.install_source: https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccx/releases/tag/v0.17.0 — upstream documents this pinned Go install command and supplies prebuilt Linux and macOS archives.

basis.shows: Reads Claude Code and Codex local sessions. Provides cross-project search, conversation views, tool/edit/error evidence, per-turn cost, session digests, JSON traces, and a local web UI. Bundled Claude Code skills and commands that invoke either agent provide client integration.

Published 2026-09-15 with Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 archives. Documents the pinned install command, Codex session costs derived from recorded token totals, and explicit unpriced/partially priced states. Costs remain estimates from pinned rates.

Contains captured Claude Code and Codex fixture tests for parsing, message counts, tool distributions, and session statistics. The Codex statistics test checks nonzero usage and a broad cost sanity range; it does not prove exact client-counter agreement.
Tests per-message usage and consistency between message, turn, and session cost totals.
Linux CI verifies dependencies, builds, runs go vet, executes go test with the race detector, and runs lint.
CI completed successfully on 2026-09-15 at c8c85c0c1b33296574174b48914b85bd51edc425, the current default-branch release commit.
Repository is not archived. License is Apache-2.0, recorded as information only.
Latest default-branch commit is dated 2026-09-15, inside the 90-day window.
An open feature request was updated 2026-08-25, establishing issue activity within the window; it is not evidence of comparative analytics quality.

not_selected.name: Confabulous

not_selected.name: tokview

Default-branch commit: 2026-07-09, so it is not stale; latest release: 2026-06-01, outside the release window; issue query returned no entries. [README](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/tokview/blob/e28578d046e1/README.md), [release](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/tokview/releases/tag/v0.0.7).

[README](https://github.com/jerrywu001/cc-sessions-viewer/blob/c81f59223af2/README.md), [release](https://github.com/jerrywu001/cc-sessions-viewer/releases/tag/v0.5.2).

not_selected.name: Claude Code History Viewer
not_selected.reason: A strong full-fit desktop/headless alternative with both agents and billing-versus-conversation analytics; held below the finalists because the latest sampled [Rust workflow](https://github.com/jhlee0409/claude-code-history-viewer/actions/runs/36797446665) has unexplained audit and documentation failures. Ubuntu, macOS and Windows test jobs, coverage and benchmarks passed, so this is not a claim of failing parser tests or proven insecurity. Commit, release and issue activity: 2026-10-01. [README](https://github.com/jhlee0409/claude-code-history-viewer/blob/090737b593d8/README.md), [release](https://github.com/jhlee0409/claude-code-history-viewer/releases/tag/v1.30.0).

not_selected.reason: Strong local accounting and self-hosted multi-machine observation for both agents, but its privacy-preserving counts and tool-kind activity serve transcript/command inspection less directly than the finalists' full conversation and trace views. Commit: 2026-09-28; release: 2026-09-27; issue update: 2026-10-01. [README](https://github.com/LockedinLabs-AI/agent-console/blob/d14755421d4a/README.md), [release](https://github.com/LockedinLabs-AI/agent-console/releases/tag/v0.4.1).

not_selected.reason: Supports both agents, Linux and macOS arm64, with token/cost and tool status; its process-oriented live monitor is a less direct fit for searching and answering questions about archived sessions. Commit: 2026-08-14; release: 2026-08-13; issue query returned no entries. [README](https://github.com/MBrassey/agtop/blob/9a056270aee9/README.md), [release](https://github.com/MBrassey/agtop/releases/tag/v2.5.0).

layers.deciding_comparison: Run agentsview v0.44.0 and ccx v0.17.0 on separate clean WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64 installs against the same frozen Claude Code and Codex corpus, including streaming updates, resumed/forked sessions, subagents, cached tokens, failures and archived sessions. Measure session/message/tool-call coverage and input/output/cache-token disagreement against client counters, using one fixed pricing snapshot and explicit unpriced cases. Time cold ingestion and a fixed question set: find a file edit, identify a failed command, reconstruct a tool sequence, and report a session's tokens and estimated cost. Repeat platform smoke checks on macOS arm64. This would decide the co-finalists; current evidence supports their capabilities and individual regression testing, not measured superiority. The layer requires no GPU computation.
evidence_gaps: Matched repository head-to-head results and direct agreement with live client counters were not found in the packet or the upstream README, release, source-test and workflow evidence reviewed. Successful CI and single-repository benchmarks do not establish cross-repository superiority.
The exact target hosts were not tested. Published Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 artifacts support platform fit; WSL2 execution remains an inference.

agentsview's documented per-session usage CLI/API exposes total output tokens and peak context tokens alongside estimated cost, rather than a complete input/output/cache breakdown. Verify the required counter comparison through its UI or exports.
agentsview's observed successful default-branch CI is from 2026-10-01, while its published release is from 2026-09-21. Later HEAD fixes must not be credited to that release without verification.

CI outcomes were inspected for the six plausible full-inspection contenders. For tokview, Agent Console, agtop and Confabulous, workflow definitions were reviewed but run outcomes were not retrieved within the API budget.

All ten repositories were unarchived and had a default-branch commit after the 2026-07-04 cutoff, so none meets the frozen stale_or_archived exclusion. Release activity differs, particularly tokview's older published release.

The requested indexed-page workflow could not be followed: ctx_fetch_and_index was rejected because it requires approval and this session's approval policy is never. Primary README, release, issue and workflow/source evidence was obtained through GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs instead. Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, zero web searches, and one blocked page-fetch attempt.
